audit.why: 46.53% over 144 games matches the prose arc: Cassiopeia owns levels 2-6, Vladimir reclaims the lane on item sustain and owns the side lane and late game. Early/mid/side-lane split is right.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes are described purely by item names with no timings, and the level 6 spike ignores that Hemoplague is a flat 120s ultimate.
audit.why: Sanguine Pool 28/25/22/19/16s and Hemoplague 120s at every rank are the two clocks the whole matchup runs on; without them 'bait it out' is untestable advice.
audit.corrected: Anchored the level 6 and first-item spikes to Pool's 28s rank-1 cooldown and Hemoplague's flat 120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'His Sanguine Pool charge' names the wrong ability — Sanguine Pool is an instant 2-second untargetable dive; the charged ability is Tides of Blood (E). Also 'Twin Fangs' should be Twin Fang.
audit.why: Riot text: Sanguine Pool — 'Vladimir sinks into a pool of blood, becoming untargetable for 2 seconds.' Tides of Blood — 'pays his own health to charge up a reservoir of blood'.
audit.corrected: Named Tides of Blood as the charged poke and Sanguine Pool as the 2-second untargetable window that eats Twin Fang, Petrifying Gaze and Ignite.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in either layer mentions Grievous Wounds against a champion whose kit is three healing abilities.
audit.why: Transfusion (Q) heals every cast, Hemoplague (R) heals per champion hit, and item sustain compounds both — anti-heal timing is the item decision of this lane.
audit.corrected: Added Oblivion Orb before the second item as an explicit want.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeGood tells you to 'walk the grounded zone's edge' and tradeBad warns about 'standing in Sanguine Pool range'.
audit.why: Vladimir has no dash, so Miasma's grounding does nothing here — the early prose already says so, and the full layer contradicts it. Sanguine Pool is self-cast, so 'Pool range' is not a thing to stand in.
audit.corrected: Rewrote both to the real trade: kite on Serpentine Grace, use the cloud for its slow, and never dump R or Ignite into the untargetable window.

edits.after: Noxious Blast into refunded Twin Fang chains a DOT a Vlad without Sanguine Pool cannot escape, and Transfusion on its 9s rank-1 cooldown will not out-heal it.

edits.after: Petrifying Gaze plus your Serpentine Grace kite cones him before Sanguine Pool is back — 28s at rank 1 — turning the poke war you won into a kill.

edits.after: Sanguine Pool the instant you commit Twin Fang or R — two seconds untargetable makes both whiff entirely

edits.before: Vlad is a weak level 1 just like you, so deny his Transfusion last-hits and set up rather than face-checking a fight you both lose. From level 2 your Noxious Blast into refunded Twin Fang starts to chain, and a Vlad without Sanguine Pool has no escape from your passive move-speed kite — punish him before he hits 6. Watch his Transfusion: every minion he last-hits with it heals him, so trade when it's on cooldown, not into it. Don't waste Miasma's grounding on him — he has no dash, so save the cloud for its slow and poison when you actually commit.
edits.after: Vlad is a weak level 1 just like you, so deny his Transfusion last-hits and set up rather than face-checking a fight you both lose. From level 2 your Noxious Blast into refunded Twin Fang starts to chain, and a Vlad without Sanguine Pool has no escape from your Serpentine Grace kite — punish him before he hits 6. Transfusion is a 9s cooldown at rank 1 and heals off every minion he takes with it, so step up on the cast, not before it. Do not waste Miasma's grounding on him — he has no dash — and drop the cloud purely for its slow when you commit.

edits.before: This is your window. With a couple ranks in Q and E your chained Twin Fangs out-DPS a pre-Riftmaker Vlad, and at 6 Petrifying Gaze answers any all-in he tries. The key is Sanguine Pool: bait it out — fake a Twin Fang commit or step in — and only burn your full combo and R once Pool is on its long cooldown, because he will Pool your R and your Twin Fang nuke the moment you show them. That single untargetable button is the one thing that turns your guaranteed trades into wasted mana.
edits.after: This is your window. With ranks in Q and E your chained Twin Fang out-DPS a pre-Riftmaker Vlad, and at 6 Petrifying Gaze answers any all-in he tries. Everything hinges on Sanguine Pool: bait it out with a fake commit or a step-in, and only spend your full combo, R and Ignite once it is down, because two seconds of untargetable eats all three and turns guaranteed trades into wasted mana. It is 28 seconds at rank 1 and still 16 at rank 5 — that gap is the whole lane, so count it.

edits.before: Past two items he reclaims this lane and you have to respect it. Full-AP Vlad heals through your entire poison DOT with Transfusion and Riftmaker, Pools your R and Ignite to dodge them, and his charged-E into Q bursts you before you can ramp Twin Fangs on a single target — and you stack no resistances to survive it. Don't trade straight up; play for picks while his Pool is down, hug your team, and let them deal with the unkillable version of him while you shred his squishier carries instead.
edits.after: Past two items he reclaims this lane and you have to respect it. Full-AP Vlad heals through your poison with Transfusion and Riftmaker, Pools your R and Ignite outright, and charged Tides of Blood into Q bursts you before Twin Fang can ramp — and you stack no resistances. Carry Grievous Wounds or none of your damage sticks. Do not trade straight up; play for picks while Pool is down, hold R for his Hemoplague commit on its flat 120s, and shred his carries instead.

edits.after: Charged Tides of Blood plus Riftmaker/Rod of Ages sustain lets him drain through your DOT and outlast you in extended trades.

edits.before: Outlast the burst poke and grind him down with the treadmill. Keep one eye on Sanguine Pool and one on the wave, in that order.
edits.after: Outlast the burst poke and grind him with the treadmill. Bait Sanguine Pool's 28 seconds out, then spend R and the fangs.

edits.before: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: matchup-defining — Untargetable dodge — bait it before you spend your kill window. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Miasma has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: matchup-defining — 28s at rank 1, 16s at rank 5, two seconds untargetable. Bait it before you spend a kill window. - Your W Miasma has one job here: its slow. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.

edits.before: Q-poison his last-hit, E twice on the poison timer, drop W as he steps at you, and walk the grounded zone's edge while the fangs finish the math.
edits.after: Q-poison his last-hit, E twice on the poison timer, and kite on Serpentine Grace — the cloud is here for its slow, not its grounding, because Vlad has no dash.

edits.before: Spamming E without poison until your mana bar dies — and then standing in Sanguine Pool range with Miasma on cooldown.
edits.after: Spamming E without poison until your mana dies — or dumping R and Ignite into the two seconds he spends untargetable in Pool.
